text:
Samir: FYI — school district just announced a snow day and I'm stuck at home. I can be online but can't get to the office if something needs hands-on. Can someone cover primary for next 6h? :snowflake:
Anya: ack, are you still able to take pages remotely? what's your connectivity?
Samir: I have stable home wifi but no laptop charger spare, battery is at ~40%. I can take pages for a bit but prefer to hand primary off if there's a risk of long shift.
Lee: I can swap, I'm local and can get to the office if we need physical access. My next rotation starts in ~1h though.
Mike: I can be secondary for the next 6 hours from home, note I'll be on call for infra-team pager at 14:00 UTC so might be noisy.
oncall-bot: [Incident notifier] Pager policy: for eng-oncall primary swap, post `@eng-oncall` and update the oncall roster. CLI: `oncall swap --from samir --to lee --duration 6h`.
Anya: Samir, quick check — any active incidents right now?
Samir: No active incidents. Last pager resolved at 11:12 UTC, all services green in console. Leaving logs link: https://redwood-infra/ops/last-24h
Lee: OK I can take primary. I'll run through runbook pointer and sticky notes. Samir — can you add handoff notes in this thread with any in-progress triggers / suspicious graphs?
Samir: copied. A few notes:
- Autoscale restart flapping on gpu-pool-3 last night, we fixed with a soft-restart; monitor `gpu-pool-3/autoscale`
- N4 latency spike at ~02:00 UTC tied to batching backlog, fixed by adjusting concurrency to 4
- Customer-facing: 1 support ticket about slower embeddings yesterday — not linked to a live incident; PR queued in ops backlog
Anya: Lee, confirm you can accept primary now and we update oncall-bot? Also please paste the exact oncall CLI you ran so oncall-bot shows the change.
Lee: running CLI now: ```oncall swap --from samir --to lee --duration 6h --reason "snow-day emergency"```
oncall-bot: Success — swap recorded. Primary: Lee (6h). Previous primary: Samir. Secondary: Mike.
Mike: noted. I'll hold secondary and monitor embedders, ping me for escalations.
Anya: Lee can you follow the primary quick-check checklist? TL;DR: check canaries, queue length, latency, and error budget. Runbook: https://redwood-docs/runbooks/oncall-primary-checklist
Lee: Doing checks now:
- canaries: OK (3/3)
- queue lengths: gpu-pool-3 spikes cleared, tail latencies within SLOs
- 95th latency for text-gen up 5% but still under alert threshold
- no active customer-impacting errors
Lee: added a short handoff note in the rota: "Taking primary for Samir due to snow day. Watch gpu-pool-3 autoscale and N4 batching backlog. Contact Mike for infra conflicts."
Samir: thanks everyone. I'll stay reachable on Slack and will grab charger from neighbor later if needed. Appreciate the quick swap. :pray:
Anya: Can someone please annotate the runbook pointer for gpu-pool-3 so future primaries see the autoscale sticky? Small snippet to paste into runbook:```
- gpu-pool-3: if autoscale flaps, first step run `kubectl rollout restart ds/gpu-pool-3` then monitor `prometheus:ALERTS{alertname="AutoscaleFlapping"}`. If persists, escalate to infra.```
Lee: pasted into runbook and linked PR: https://redwood-docs/prs/3215
ops-bot: Reminder — if you perform a manual restart, file a short postmortem comment in the incident tracker within 24h.
Samir: +1 on that. If anything lands, tag me and I can take follow-up in the evening.
Mike: I'll set a watch on embedders and set a quick pager filter so non-urgent infra-only noise doesn't bubble into primary.
Anya: Great. Closing loop: Primary=Lee (now), Secondary=Mike, previous Primary=Samir. Coverage window ~6h (1950001111 -> 1950001675). Everyone clear?
Lee: clear.
Samir: clear, thanks again.
Mike: clear :thumbsup:
